t: This is Chener Books, a bookstore here in the UK. The material I have on it is very thin. What I can tell you is that Miranda Peake owned the shop, so it was her bookshop. Beyond that I don't have reliable details about its history or what it specialises in, and I'd rather say less than make something up. If you're nearby, it's worth stepping in and asking the staff about the shop's story.
